report_md:
## Vacancy finding — 112 4th St, Oakland (APN 001 016300500)

**Verdict:** likely_vacant (confidence 0.68). The commercial building is listed as currently available for lease, with LoopNet reporting a 2025-10-02 on-market date. A February 2025 sale brochure says electrical wiring was removed and repairs were needed. Together these support likely vacancy or non-operation, but neither listing nor the wiring note proves that the property was empty.

**Vacancy start:** not confirmed. The 2025-10-02 listing is the earliest dated evidence located that the full commercial space was being marketed for lease, not a verified vacancy start. **Duration:** unknown; it may have been vacant since being marketed in October 2025 (about one year as of 2026-10-15), but continuous vacancy is not established. Oakland's 2018-2019 blight record is an older condition signal and does not bridge the gap.

Sources: [LoopNet listing](https://www.loopnet.com/Listing/112-4th-St-Oakland-CA/37915415/), [Gordon Commercial sale brochure](https://www.gordoncommercial.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/112_4thStreetOAK_ForSale_F1b-1.pdf), [Oakland Q4 2019 code-enforcement report](https://www.oaklandca.gov/files/assets/city/v/1/planning-amp-building/documents/ce/bce-reports/code-enforcement-quarterly-report-inspection-count-q4-april-1-june-30-2019.pdf).
